Title: February 12, 2026 - Boulder City Council Special Meeting
Overview: The special meeting covered a public hearing on whether the Area 3 Planning Reserve warranted further consideration of a service area expansion plan, a city manager matter on reconsidering comprehensive plan community change requests, a municipal court update, and a council community engagement discussion. Council voted 7-2 to find sufficient community need to continue exploring expansion, and directed staff to draft a guardrails resolution for consent agenda adoption at a future meeting.

Topic1.Title: Area 3 Planning Reserve Service Area Expansion Need Determination
Topic1.Summary: Staff presented a step two community needs assessment for the Area 3 Planning Reserve covering housing, fire storage, aging-related facilities, regional parkland, food systems, and renewable energy. Council questioned housing gap figures, parkland standards, water and wildfire resource impacts, staff capacity, and phasing. Planning board had voted 4-3 against continuing, and public speakers were split. Council approved the finding of sufficient need 7-2, with Wallik and Adams opposed.

Topic2.Title: Comprehensive Plan Community Change Requests Reconsideration
Topic2.Summary: Staff reported that Boulder County commissioners supported reconsidering three land use requests and two policy requests that staff and the other bodies did not recommend advancing. Staff explained the policy edits already underway and why the requests were not recommended. Council raised no interest in reconsidering any of the requests, so no further action was taken.

Topic3.Title: Municipal Court 2025 Update and 2026 Work Plan
Topic3.Summary: Judge Khan and Court Administrator Devon Kiss Kelly reviewed 2025 case filings, including rising traffic, photo enforcement, and criminal cases, and a rise in quality-of-life citations near CU. They described the community court, restorative programs, parking appeals, and the new public data dashboard. They also noted the Colorado Supreme Court's CAMP decision and pending public defender legislation. Council asked about traffic enforcement effectiveness, party-related enforcement, and the dashboard.

Topic4.Title: Council Community Engagement Options for 2026
Topic4.Summary: Staff presented a menu of council engagement formats, including chats with council, council-initiated chats, office hours, community connectors events, and community and council forums. Council expressed interest in continuing chats and forums, with a nominated bike parking walk-and-talk downtown. Members discussed rotating topics and limiting labor-intensive events. Staff will take the feedback to the council engagement committee and return to council.
